interest: Provides comprehensive SCAP baseline statistics on early postwar Japanese labor unions, plus a curious inquiry regarding Nichiran Aluminium.
overview: This file primarily consists of Foreign Service Despatch No. 581 (September 1948), transmitting a comprehensive 48-page statistical survey compiled by the SCAP Economic and Scientific Section's Labor Division on Japanese labor unions and federations as of December 31, 1947. The survey presents extensive data across twenty-five tables detailing union membership, national federation affiliations including Sodomei and Sanbetsu, industrial distributions, collective bargaining agreements, union dues, and prefectural breakdowns. Additionally, the file contains an unrelated April 1948 inquiry letter from a resident in Greece concerning the wartime disappearance of the Nichiran Aluminium Company and connected personnel in Tokyo.
